runtime.safe_ui_interpretation: Show as runtime status badge (available/unavailable/configured). 'authority_detail' may contain technical governance text for tooltip.
runtime.unavailable_semantics: mlx_available=false means MLX not installed on this machine. Runtime unavailable.

health.safe_ui_interpretation: Show state as health badge (Healthy/Degraded/Unconfigured/Error). Display GPU availability. Show shutdown_complete as 'Runtime inactive' when true.
health.unavailable_semantics: state=UNCONFIGURED means MLX not available. state=DEGRADED means inventory scan failed. shutdown_complete=true means runtime was shut down — needs restart.

terminal_outcomes.safe_ui_interpretation: Show as summary counts in a dashboard card. Totals are from evidence ledger reconstruction. Only display when reconstruction_available=true.
terminal_outcomes.unavailable_semantics: reconstruction_available=false means evidence ledgers are missing, corrupt, or empty. Hide counter display.

evidence_health.safe_ui_interpretation: Show as green/red status dots for each ledger. Show line counts. last_write_at is ISO timestamp. reconstruction_available gates all evidence-dependent views.
evidence_health.unavailable_semantics: All ledger_exists=false means no evidence written yet. Normal for fresh install.

queue_health.safe_ui_interpretation: Show as 'Queue: N queued, M running, T processed' dashboard card.

scheduler.safe_ui_interpretation: Show batching_status as badge (fcfs_serialized, active_batch_generator, fallback_serialized, unavailable). batch_engine explains the active engine. active_operations lists current op IDs.

cache.safe_ui_interpretation: Show cache_stats hit/miss counts. ssd_cache section shows SSD persistence status. Display privacy class.
cache.unavailable_semantics: ssd_cache.enabled=false means SSD persistence is not configured.

pool.safe_ui_interpretation: Show loaded model count, max capacity, active/pending unload counts.

bridge.safe_ui_interpretation: Show whether session context is bound. mode_detail explains execution capability.
bridge.unavailable_semantics: mode=stateless_preflight_only means tool execution deferred to X0 integration.

tool_proposal_status.unavailable_semantics: execution_mode=stateless_preflight_only means proposals detected but not executed.

cancellation_refusal_summary.safe_ui_interpretation: Show as dashboard summary counts. High cancellation/error counts indicate problems.
cancellation_refusal_summary.unavailable_semantics: All zeros or unavailable when reconstruction_available=false.

capabilities.safe_ui_interpretation: Show as feature grid. SUPPORTED=green, V1_REQUIRED_PENDING=yellow, DEFERRED=grey, active_local_trie=green, deferred=grey.
capabilities.unavailable_semantics: Values may be CapabilityPosture enum values or special strings like 'active_local_trie' or 'deferred'. Render all non-SUPPORTED as pending/deferred.

privacy.safe_ui_interpretation: Show privacy status. degraded_status=operational is normal. degraded_status=degraded means warnings present.
privacy.unavailable_semantics: degraded_status=degraded indicates one of: load/unload evidence failure, SSD integrity warning, or shutdown warnings.

governance.safe_ui_interpretation: Display as governance status section with descriptive text labels.
governance.unavailable_semantics: All governance fields are descriptive strings. No unavailable state — always present.

models.safe_ui_interpretation: Show model counts. 'lifecycle_events' is ledger filename reference.
models.unavailable_semantics: All zeros means no models discovered or loaded.
